title: Trusting Allah's Plan After a Failed Business
paragraphs: After his small online shop failed to attract enough customers within its first year, Karim felt he had wasted his savings and his time on something that clearly did not work.
His father reminded him gently that every experience, even a failed one, was part of Allah's plan and could teach him something useful for whatever came next in his life.
Karim did not fully believe this at first, still upset about the lost money, but he started paying attention to what specifically had gone wrong with his approach.
Slowly, he realized the failure taught him real lessons about pricing and customer service that he had never properly understood before starting his first business attempt.
A year later, starting a new, smaller business with this hard-earned knowledge, Karim felt more prepared, understanding that his first failure had quietly prepared him for this second try.
